item.title: 'Largest' tax refunds? How much cash will actually hit Americans’ bank accounts?
item.description: Americans can anticipate significantly larger tax refunds next year, potentially an extra $1,000 per filer. This boost is attributed to Donald Trump's 'One Big Beautiful Bill Act,' signed into law in July. Treasury officials project these refunds to be the largest in history, offering financial relief amidst cost-of-living concerns, though some Democrats remain critical.
item.dc:creator: TOI Business Desk

item.title: Pardoned but still in prison? What’s really keeping Trump's ally Tina Peters locked up
item.description: Donald Trump issued a pardon to former Mesa County clerk Tina Peters for her efforts to expose voter fraud in the 2020 election. Trump accused Democrats of prosecuting election integrity advocates while ignoring violent crime. Despite the pardon, Peters remains in jail as presidential pardons do not apply to state convictions.

item.title: 'Nicolas Maduro’s nephews, oil tankers': US imposes new sanctions on Venezuela — details
item.description: The United States imposed new sanctions on Venezuela, targeting three nephews of President Maduro's wife and six oil tankers. This action follows a US military buildup in the Caribbean and a recent seizure of a sanctioned oil tanker. The move has escalated tensions between Washington and Caracas, with Maduro denouncing the seizure as "naval piracy."

item.title: Deportation airlines: DHS signs $140 million deal to buy 6 Boeing 737 jets
item.description: The US Department of Homeland Security is acquiring six Boeing 737 aircraft for nearly $140 million, enabling Immigration and Customs Enforcement to operate its own deportation fleet. This significant investment, funded by a record enforcement budget, aims to boost deportation flights and operational efficiency. The contract was awarded to a new firm, Daedalus Aviation, raising questions about cost-effectiveness and logistics.

item.title: Australian teens can’t stream on Twitch anymore due to new regulations
item.description: Australian teens under 16 now face new Twitch restrictions. New accounts are banned, and existing ones for this age group will be deactivated in January 2026. This move, driven by Australian online safety laws, aims to protect minors. While watching remains possible, streaming and chatting are halted until users turn 16 and verify their age.

item.title: ‘Release him immediately’: Federal judge orders ICE to free wrongfully deported migrant Kilmar Abrego Garcia
item.description: A federal judge has ordered the immediate release of Kilmar Abrego Garcia from US immigration detention. He was wrongfully deported to El Salvador and later re-detained without lawful authority. The judge ruled his custody had no legal basis as he lacks a valid removal order and deportation plans are unworkable. The government condemned the ruling and plans to appeal.

item.title: Valkyrae’s “questions she’s never been asked” video reveals her long-term streaming plans
item.description: Streaming sensation Valkyrae revealed her long-term plans to continue gaming and streaming well into her 70s, highlighting her enduring passion. She envisions integrating new tech like the ROG Xbox Ally for portable play, from home to beach vacations. This dedication showcases a sustainable career fueled by love for gaming, inspiring many.

item.title: Everything to know about MrBeast’s Beast Games season 2: Premiere date, prize money, and participant lineup
item.description: MrBeast's 'Beast Games' returns to Prime Video on January 7, 2026, with a colossal $5 million prize. Filmed partly in Saudi Arabia, the competition intensifies with a blend of physical and mental challenges, promising unprecedented scale and spectacle for viewers.

item.title: Multiple US states to send tax relief payments: Check list and amount
item.description: Several US states are providing tax relief payments before the end of 2025 to help residents cope with rising living costs. Alaska, New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania are distributing rebates, dividends, and property tax reductions. These state-run programs offer financial support to eligible individuals and families facing economic strain.

item.title: Meet Karandeep Anand and Sriram Krishnan: Indian-origin innovators named 'AI architects' in TIME’s Person of the Year
item.description: Two Indian-origin innovators, Karandeep Anand and Sriram Krishnan, are recognized by TIME as "Architects of AI." Anand leads Character.AI, revolutionizing consumer AI interaction, while Krishnan shapes US AI policy as a White House advisor. Their inclusion underscores the significant influence of Indian leadership in steering AI's global trajectory and its societal impact.

item.title: Here’s what NASA wants you to know about galaxy clusters
item.description: NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory has revealed stunning cosmic structures within galaxy clusters, like bubbles and waves, formed by superheated gas and black hole activity. A new technique, X-arithmetic, decodes these X-ray signals by analyzing energy bands, offering unprecedented insights into the powerful forces shaping these massive cosmic systems and regulating star formation.
